turns: There is a one-line bug in parser.py (an off-by-one). Fix it and commit the change.

events.command:
git add parser.py && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(parser): correct off-by-one error in head function

The head function was returning xs[1] (second element) instead of xs[0]
(first element), causing it to skip the first item in the list.
EOF
)"

events.text: Done. Fixed the off-by-one error in `head()` — changed `xs[1]` to `xs[0]` so it returns the first element instead of the second. Committed as `4225aea`.
